tag: 三大指數全收紅，週線全部上漲
zh: 週五（10/9）標普 500 收 7,811.54（+0.59%）、道瓊 51,654.95（+0.83%，漲 423 點）、那斯達克 27,366.17（+0.64%），羅素 2000 收 2,806.98（+0.46%），VIX 降到 14.84。三大指數本週都是上漲，標普 500 距離歷史高點只差一小段。週四才因為 OpenAI 營收疑慮重挫的科技股，週五明顯反彈，油價回落也減輕了壓力。
en: On Friday (Oct. 9) the S&P 500 closed at 7,811.54 (+0.59%), the Dow at 51,654.95 (+0.83%, up 423 points) and the Nasdaq at 27,366.17 (+0.64%); the Russell 2000 ended at 2,806.98 (+0.46%) and the VIX fell to 14.84. All three major indexes finished the week higher, and the S&P 500 is within striking distance of its record. Tech, which sold off on Thursday over OpenAI revenue doubts, rebounded clearly, and lower oil eased pressure.

stocks.n: 那斯達克 100 ETF，綜合指數 +0.64%

tag: 電信三雄一日重挫，SpaceX 成了新變數
zh: T-Mobile 週五大跌約 13% 收 148.58 美元，AT&T 跌約 9.8% 收 22.18 美元，Verizon 跌約 8.8% 收 41.65 美元，三家都跌超過 7%。Yahoo Finance 的說法是，投資人把 SpaceX 買進全國性頻譜、跨足行動服務的動作視為可信的威脅。電信股一向被當成防禦與高股息，這樣的單日跌幅很罕見；不過 SpaceX 是否真能搶走用戶，目前仍是市場預期，不是已發生的事實。
en: T-Mobile fell about 13% to $148.58 on Friday, AT&T about 9.8% to $22.18 and Verizon about 8.8% to $41.65, all three down more than 7%. Yahoo Finance said investors read SpaceX's purchase of nationwide spectrum and push into mobile service as a credible threat. Carriers are usually treated as defensive, high-dividend names, so a one-day drop this size is rare; whether SpaceX can actually take subscribers is still an expectation, not a fact.

stocks.n: T-Mobile，約 -13% 收 148.58 美元
Verizon，約 -8.8% 收 41.65 美元

tag: 殖利率仍在高檔，黃金大漲 1.5%
zh: 十年期公債殖利率週五約在 5.24% 到 5.25%，接近本週觸及的 24 年高點，只算從高處小退。黃金漲 1.52% 到每盎司 4,220.30 美元，比特幣漲 0.73% 到 82,434 美元。同一天股市上漲、黃金也上漲，代表資金一邊買風險、一邊仍保留避險部位，市場對高利率與地緣局勢都沒有完全放心。
en: The 10-year Treasury yield was about 5.24% to 5.25% on Friday, close to the 24-year high touched earlier this week and only a small step back from it. Gold rose 1.52% to $4,220.30 an ounce and bitcoin gained 0.73% to $82,434. Stocks and gold rising together suggests money is buying risk while still holding hedges, so the market has not fully relaxed about high rates or geopolitics.

stocks.n: 黃金 ETF，黃金現貨期貨 +1.52% 到 4,220.30 美元
長天期公債 ETF，殖利率仍在 24 年高點附近
比特幣現貨 ETF，比特幣 +0.73% 到 82,434 美元

tag: Moderna 領漲藥股，健康險與 REIT 也強
zh: Moderna 週五大漲約 9% 至 14%（各處數字不同），Yahoo 的說法與《紐約時報》報導一項全國性癌症疫苗計畫有關，輝瑞、BioNTech、默克跟著走高。另外 Humana 漲約 11.6%、Crown Castle 漲約 15.6%。這些漲幅各有不同催化，來源沒有把全部原因寫清楚，請把它們當作「當天資金流向」，不要當成同一個主題。
en: Moderna jumped roughly 9% to 14% on Friday (figures differ by display), which Yahoo linked to a New York Times report on a national cancer vaccine initiative, and Pfizer, BioNTech and Merck rose with it. Humana gained about 11.6% and Crown Castle about 15.6%. Each had its own catalyst and the source does not spell out all of them, so treat these as the day's money flows rather than one theme.

stocks.n: Moderna，約 +9% 至 +14%，癌症疫苗報導帶動
輝瑞，隨 Moderna 走高
Humana，約 +11.6%
Crown Castle，約 +15.6%

tag: Delta 財報低於預期並下修全年，燃油是主因
zh: Delta 第三季調整後營收 175.8 億美元（年增 15.7%），略低於預期的 177.6 億；調整後每股盈餘 1.72 美元，低於 Yahoo 引用的預期 1.82 美元，也低於公司 7 月自己給的 2.00 至 2.50 美元指引。燃油支出 41 億美元，年增 62%，比 7 月預估多約 5 億美元；公司下修全年展望，並說全年燃油帳單將增加約 60 億美元。高端艙等需求強勁，仍然抵不過油價。股價收盤大致持平至小跌。
en: Delta's third-quarter adjusted revenue was $17.58 billion (+15.7%), a bit below the $17.76 billion expected; adjusted EPS was $1.72, below the $1.82 estimate Yahoo cited and below the company's own July guidance of $2.00 to $2.50. Fuel cost was $4.1 billion, up 62% and about $500 million above the July forecast; Delta cut its full-year outlook and said its annual fuel bill will rise by roughly $6 billion. Premium-cabin strength could not offset fuel. The stock closed roughly flat to slightly lower.

stocks.n: Delta，EPS 1.72 美元低於預期，下修全年展望
聯合航空，同樣吃油價，下週財報待查
航空類股 ETF，燃油成本的整體對照

tag: 財報季週二開跑：四大銀行同日，BofA、摩根士丹利週三
zh: 路透 10/9 的週前瞻指出，JPMorgan、Goldman Sachs、Citigroup 與 Wells Fargo 週二（10/13）公布財報，Bank of America 與 Morgan Stanley 週三接棒，這幾家打開第三季財報季。LSEG 預期標普 500 成分公司第三季獲利合計年增 30.6%，由能源與科技領軍。據 digrin 行事曆，JPMorgan 預期每股盈餘約 5.82 美元、Goldman 約 16.42 美元；在十年期殖利率逾 5% 的環境下，大家看的是淨利息收入、信用成本與投資銀行業務是否回溫。
en: Reuters' Oct. 9 week-ahead says JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and Wells Fargo report Tuesday (Oct. 13), with Bank of America and Morgan Stanley following Wednesday, opening third-quarter earnings season. LSEG expects aggregate S&P 500 third-quarter earnings to rise 30.6% from a year earlier, led by energy and technology. Per the digrin calendar, JPMorgan is expected to earn about $5.82 a share and Goldman about $16.42; with the 10-year yield above 5%, the focus is net interest income, credit costs and whether investment banking is recovering.

stocks.n: JPMorgan，週二財報，預期 EPS 約 5.82 美元
Goldman Sachs，週二財報，預期 EPS 約 16.42 美元
Wells Fargo，週二與三家大行同日財報
Bank of America，週三財報

tag: 成本壓力同一週出現：PepsiCo 與 Delta 都下修
zh: 本週兩家不同行業的大公司，財報裡講的是同一件事：成本。PepsiCo 把核心每股盈餘成長展望下修為 2.5% 至 3%，Delta 則因燃油比預期貴約 5 億美元而下修全年。一個賣零食飲料，一個賣機票，共同點是原物料與能源價格往上，而需求本身沒有崩。後面要看的是，下週的銀行與之後的消費、運輸財報，會不會出現同樣的說法。
en: Two large companies in different industries told the same story this week: costs. PepsiCo cut its core EPS growth outlook to 2.5% to 3%, and Delta cut its full-year view because fuel ran about $500 million above its forecast. One sells snacks and drinks, the other sells tickets; what they share is rising commodity and energy prices while demand itself has not collapsed. The question is whether next week's banks and later consumer and transport reports repeat that language.

stocks.n: PepsiCo，核心 EPS 展望下修為 2.5% 至 3%
必需消費 ETF，成本轉嫁能力的整體對照
工業類股 ETF，運輸與製造成本的整體對照

tag: 密大消費者信心 46.3，是 5 月以來新低
zh: 密西根大學 10 月消費者信心初值降到 46.3，是 5 月以來最低；前一個月的一年期通膨預期為 4.6%。信心低落加上通膨預期偏高，是 Fed 最不想看到的組合：想壓通膨要維持高利率，但高利率又在壓抑消費。不過信心調查是情緒，不等於實際花費；下週的零售銷售（10/15）才是更硬的檢驗。
en: The University of Michigan's preliminary October consumer sentiment reading fell to 46.3, the lowest since May, and the prior month's one-year inflation expectation was 4.6%. Weak confidence with high inflation expectations is the combination the Fed likes least: holding rates high fights inflation but weighs on spending. Sentiment is a mood survey, not actual spending, though; next week's retail sales (Oct. 15) are the harder test.

stocks.n: 零售類股 ETF，消費信心低落的直接對照
非必需消費 ETF，對信心與利率最敏感
抗通膨公債 ETF，通膨預期的觀察指標

tag: 川普成立委員會，調查 Fed 理事 Cook
zh: Yahoo Finance 報導，川普成立了一個委員會，調查針對 Fed 理事 Lisa Cook 的房貸詐欺指控，並由委員會建議是否有法律依據將她免職。這件事在利率最敏感的時刻出現，市場關心的不是 Cook 個人，而是 Fed 的獨立性：如果理事能被政治壓力影響，長天期殖利率與風險溢酬可能要求更高的補償。目前只是調查，尚無任何免職結果。
en: Yahoo Finance reported that Trump formed a committee to investigate mortgage fraud allegations against Fed governor Lisa Cook and to advise whether there is legal cause to remove her. With rates at a sensitive point, the market cares less about Cook herself than about Fed independence: if governors can be moved by political pressure, long-dated yields and risk premiums may demand more compensation. It is only an investigation so far, with no removal outcome.

stocks.n: 長天期公債 ETF，對 Fed 獨立性與期限溢酬最敏感
區域銀行 ETF，對利率路徑與曲線形狀敏感

tag: 十年期殖利率一週：先創 2002 年來新高，再退一步
zh: 十年期殖利率本週三盤中觸及 5.36%（2002 年來高點），週四收 5.23%，週五約 5.24% 至 5.25%，等於在高檔盤整，沒有明顯下降。債券市場週一（10/12）因哥倫布日休市，所以下一個大的利率資訊要等週三（10/14）美東上午 8:30 的 9 月 CPI。我找不到可靠的 CPI 共識預期，請到彭博或路透看最新預測。
en: The 10-year yield touched 5.36% intraday on Wednesday (the highest since 2002), closed at 5.23% on Thursday and sat around 5.24% to 5.25% on Friday, so it is consolidating near the high rather than falling. The bond market is closed Monday (Oct. 12) for Columbus Day, so the next big rates input is the September CPI on Wednesday (Oct. 14) at 8:30 a.m. ET. I could not find a reliable CPI consensus; check Bloomberg or Reuters for current forecasts.

stocks.n: 7 至 10 年期公債 ETF，十年期殖利率約 5.24%
短天期公債 ETF，對升息預期最敏感

tag: AI 概念反彈：OpenAI 數字出現兩種版本
zh: 週四的 AI 賣壓來自《金融時報》報導 OpenAI 年化營收約 500 億美元、比預期少約 200 億；週五彭博報導 OpenAI 預期年底前年化營收至少 700 億美元，科技股隨之反彈，軟體股也從前一輪「SaaSpocalypse」賣壓中回補。英特爾卻逆勢下跌約 2.2%。重點是：同一家公司兩份報導就能讓一個板塊一天跌、一天漲，代表 AI 交易目前由消息面主導，不是基本面單日改變。
en: Thursday's AI selloff came from a Financial Times report that OpenAI's annualized revenue is about $50 billion, roughly $20 billion below estimates; on Friday Bloomberg reported OpenAI expects at least $70 billion annualized by year-end, and tech rebounded while software stocks bounced from the earlier 'SaaSpocalypse' selling. Intel still fell about 2.2%. The point: two reports on one company can swing a sector down one day and up the next, so the AI trade is currently driven by headlines rather than daily fundamentals.

stocks.n: 那斯達克 100 ETF，科技股反彈的整體對照
軟體類股 ETF，軟體股從賣壓中回補
英特爾，逆勢約 -2.2%

tag: 防禦股不防禦：電信一天跌掉高股息的緩衝
zh: 電信股常被當成「領股息、波動小」的防禦選擇，但週五 T-Mobile、AT&T、Verizon 單日跌 9% 到 13%，高股息殖利率要好幾個月才能補回一天的價差。這提醒我們，防禦股也有自己的「單一風險」：當市場開始想像新進者搶客戶，估值會先被重新定價。若你以為持有電信等於避險，今天是一個很好的反例；要不要降低曝險，是各人風險承受度的事，不是這裡的建議。
en: Telecom stocks are often treated as a 'collect the dividend, low volatility' defensive choice, but on Friday T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon fell 9% to 13% in a day, a drop that months of dividend yield would take a long time to repay. It is a reminder that defensive stocks carry single-name risk too: when the market imagines a new entrant taking customers, valuation reprices first. Whether to cut exposure depends on individual risk tolerance and is not advice here.

stocks.n: 通訊服務類股 ETF，電信與媒體的整體對照
T-Mobile，單日約 -13%
Verizon，單日約 -8.8%，高股息代表

tag: 能源與運輸：油價回落，但航空仍在算燃油帳
zh: WTI 週五收在 91.66 美元（+0.19%），布蘭特約 104 美元；盤中油價回落，原因是川普說俄羅斯會立即供應超過 30 萬噸柴油，11 月起還會增加，並重申期中選舉（11/3）前不會攻擊伊朗。對航空與貨運是短線喘息，但 Delta 的財報顯示，燃油成本已經高到影響全年；Hormuz 周邊的緊張沒有解除，油價能否持續回落仍要看後續供給。
en: WTI settled at $91.66 on Friday (+0.19%) and Brent was around $104; oil eased intraday after Trump said Russia would immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel, with more from November, and repeated that the U.S. would not attack Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms. That is short-term relief for airlines and freight, but Delta's report shows fuel costs are already high enough to affect the full year; tensions around Hormuz have not gone away, so whether oil keeps falling depends on supply.

stocks.n: 能源類股 ETF，油價的受惠側
美國原油 ETF，WTI 收 91.66 美元
聯邦快遞，貨運燃油成本的對照

zh: 羅素 2000 週五收 2,806.98（+0.46%），漲幅比標普 500（+0.59%）略小。以前一日 2,794.13 對應「距 8/12 高點低 8.3%」反推，高點約在 3,047，所以現在仍低約 7.9%（推算值，非官方數字）。小型股的難處很清楚：利率在 24 年高點附近，借款成本壓著它們，但大型股的指數創高又讓資金不急著轉向。
en: The Russell 2000 closed at 2,806.98 on Friday (+0.46%), a bit less than the S&P 500's 0.59%. Working back from Thursday's 2,794.13 and the 'down 8.3% from the Aug. 12 high' figure, the high is near 3,047, so the index is still about 7.9% below it (an estimate, not an official number). The difficulty for small caps is clear: rates are near a 24-year high and weigh on borrowing costs, while record-area large-cap indexes leave little urgency for money to rotate.

stocks.n: 標普小型 600 ETF，品質較高的小型股對照
區域銀行 ETF，小型股裡權重高的族群

tag: Fastly、Novavax、Hims 單日大漲，各自為政
zh: Fastly 漲約 15.9%、Novavax 約 15.8%、Hims & Hers 約 10.2%。來源只列出漲幅，沒有逐一說明原因，三家分屬雲端邊緣運算、疫苗與遠距醫療，沒有共同主題。這種「單日漲逾一成」的小型股，隔天常見到相當比例的回吐，單日數字不能當作趨勢；比較有用的做法是去看它們的催化事件是否有營收或合約支撐。
en: Fastly rose about 15.9%, Novavax about 15.8% and Hims & Hers about 10.2%. The source lists the gains without explaining each, and the three span edge computing, vaccines and telehealth, so there is no shared theme. Small caps that jump 10%+ in a day often give back part of it the next session, so one day's number is not a trend; the better check is whether the catalyst is backed by revenue or contracts.

stocks.n: Fastly，約 +15.9%
Novavax，約 +15.8%
Hims & Hers，約 +10.2%

tag: AST SpaceMobile 跌約 10%：SpaceX 題材的另一面
zh: AST SpaceMobile（ASTS）週五跌約 10.5%，和電信三雄同一天下跌。它做的是衛星直連手機，與 SpaceX 走同一條技術路線；當市場認為 SpaceX 的行動服務可信時，同賽道的小公司不但沒有跟著受益，反而被視為更弱的競爭者。這是小型題材股常見的特性：大公司進場往往先改變估值，而不是帶來訂單。
en: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) fell about 10.5% on Friday, the same day the three big carriers dropped. It works on satellite-direct-to-phone service, the same technical road as SpaceX; when the market sees SpaceX's mobile push as credible, a smaller company on that road is not lifted but viewed as a weaker competitor. It is common for theme small caps: a large entrant tends to change valuation first, not bring orders.

stocks.n: AST SpaceMobile，約 -10.5%

tag: 小型股判讀：利率 5.2% 時，哪些比較難受
zh: 長天期殖利率升高時，小型股受傷的路徑通常有兩條：一是浮動利率或即將到期需要再融資的債務，利息成本上升；二是估值——未來現金流的折現率變高，獲利還沒出來的成長股最吃虧。反過來，現金多、負債低、已經穩定獲利的小型股比較能撐住。看一家小公司時，先查它的利息保障倍數與債務到期時程，比看本週漲跌更有用。
en: When long-dated yields rise, small caps are usually hurt through two paths: floating-rate or soon-to-mature debt that must be refinanced, which raises interest costs, and valuation, since a higher discount rate hits growth names with profits still ahead the hardest. Small caps with cash, low debt and steady earnings hold up better. For any small company, check interest coverage and the debt maturity schedule before looking at this week's move.

stocks.n: 標普小型 600 ETF，獲利門檻較高的對照
小型價值 ETF，低估值小型股的對照

tag: 小型股判讀：漲 15% 不等於你賺到 15%
zh: 小型股的日均成交量小，買賣價差（bid-ask spread）較寬，單日漲跌 15% 時，實際成交價常常和你在畫面上看到的差一截，進出越多、成本越高。流動性好的大型股一天可以輕鬆成交，小型股一張大單就可能自己推高股價。所以看到 Fastly、Novavax 這類單日大漲，先看成交量與價差再決定是否值得追，是比預測方向更務實的功課。
en: Small caps trade lower daily volume and carry wider bid-ask spreads, so on a 15% day the price you actually get can differ noticeably from the screen, and more trading means more cost. Large caps absorb big orders easily; a single large order can push a small cap on its own. When you see Fastly or Novavax jump, checking volume and spread before deciding to chase is more practical than predicting direction.

stocks.n: Fastly，單日約 +15.9%，成交價差的例子
Novavax，單日約 +15.8%

tag: Outset Medical：大股東 10 月初砍進 87 萬美元，HCA 簽 4,000 萬美元換機約
zh: Outset Medical（OM）做的是 Tablo 家用／院內血液透析系統，7 月初市值只有約 8,000 萬美元（價格資料已過時，請查即時報價），分析師覆蓋與媒體聲量都不高。Q2 營收 3,160 萬美元（年增 1%、季增 14%），毛利率從 37.8% 升到 42.0%，並簽下與 HCA Healthcare 為期三年、4,000 萬美元的 Tablo 機隊更新合約。內部人面：據 Quiver Quantitative 追蹤，董事兼 10% 持股人 Braden Michael Leonard 在 10 月 1 至 2 日以約 3.53 至 3.88 美元買進，合計約 87 萬美元，Form 4 我沒能親自核對。風險：產品營收年減 5%、單季仍燒掉 950 萬美元現金，成長主要靠服務收入。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Outset Medical (OM) makes the Tablo hemodialysis system; in early July its market cap was only about $80 million (that price data is stale, check a live quote), with thin coverage and little media attention. Q2 revenue was $31.6 million (+1% year over year, +14% sequentially), gross margin rose to 42.0% from 37.8%, and it signed a three-year, $40 million Tablo fleet-refresh agreement with HCA Healthcare. On insiders: per Quiver Quantitative, director and 10% holder Braden Michael Leonard bought about $870,000 of stock on Oct. 1 to 2 at roughly $3.53 to $3.88; I could not check the Form 4 myself. Risks: product revenue fell 5%, the company still burned $9.5 million of cash in the quarter, and growth leans on service revenue. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Outset Medical，Q2 毛利率 42.0%，HCA 簽 4,000 萬美元合約，大股東 10 月初買進

tag: Union Bankshares：Q2 盈餘 +21%，董事 8 月買 1,000 股
zh: Union Bankshares（UNB）是佛蒙特州的社區銀行，總資產 15.6 億美元。Q2 淨利 290 萬美元、每股 0.61 美元，去年同期 240 萬、0.53 美元；其中含出售分行房產的一次性收益 38 萬美元。據 InsiderTrades 標題，董事 David Scott Silverman 在 8 月底買進 1,000 股，但價位與日期我沒能確認。風險：非利息支出成長 9.3%，高於營收成長，且內部人買進金額很小。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Union Bankshares (UNB) is a Vermont community bank with $1.56 billion in assets. Q2 net income was $2.9 million, or $0.61 a share, versus $2.4 million and $0.53 a year earlier, including a one-time $380,000 gain on a branch property sale. An InsiderTrades headline says director David Scott Silverman bought 1,000 shares in late August, though I could not confirm price or date. Risks: noninterest expense grew 9.3%, faster than revenue, and the insider purchase is small. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

tag: Bank of the James：上半年淨利 +69%，總資產約 10 億美元
zh: Bank of the James（BOTJ）是維吉尼亞州的社區銀行，總資產 10.41 億美元。Q2 淨利 324 萬美元、每股 0.71 美元，去年同期 270 萬、0.60 美元；上半年淨利 601 萬美元，去年同期 355 萬，主因是淨利息收入成長與非利息支出下降。董事 Jamerson 今年 2 月與 5 月有小額買進，但聚合資料有明顯錯誤，金額請以 Form 4 為準。風險：規模小、流動性低，區域銀行對利率與信用品質都敏感。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Bank of the James (BOTJ) is a Virginia community bank with $1.041 billion in assets. Q2 net income was $3.24 million, or $0.71 a share, versus $2.70 million and $0.60 a year earlier; first-half net income was $6.01 million versus $3.55 million, driven by higher net interest income and lower noninterest expense. Director Jamerson made small purchases in February and May, but aggregator data contain clear errors, so rely on Form 4 for amounts. Risks: small size and thin liquidity, and regional banks are sensitive to rates and credit quality. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Bank of the James，上半年淨利 601 萬美元，去年同期 355 萬

tag: Cardinal Infrastructure：2026 營收指引上調到 8.8 至 9 億美元
zh: 池內的 Cardinal Infrastructure（CDNL）8 月 11 日公布 Q2：營收 2.269 億美元，年增 114%（有機成長 64%），並把全年營收指引上調到 8.8 億至 9 億美元，中位數增加 2.1 億；同時宣布收購亞特蘭大的 Allied Paving（年營收約 1.08 億、調整後 EBITDA 利潤率 20.3%），是今年第三筆收購。風險：Q2 淨利從 717 萬降到 468 萬，成長主要靠收購，整合與資金來源都要觀察。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Cardinal Infrastructure (CDNL), already in the pool, reported Q2 on Aug. 11: revenue of $226.9 million, up 114% (64% organic), and raised full-year revenue guidance to $880 million to $900 million, with the midpoint up $210 million; it also announced the acquisition of Allied Paving of Atlanta (about $108 million of annual revenue at a 20.3% adjusted EBITDA margin), its third deal this year. Risks: Q2 net income fell from $7.17 million to $4.68 million, growth leans on acquisitions, and integration and funding need watching. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

tag: IRIDEX：青光眼探頭用量 +35%，營運現金流轉正，CFO 連續小額買進
zh: IRIDEX（IRIX）做眼科雷射，營收只有一季約 1,260 萬美元，是典型沒人追的微型醫材股。Q2 營收年減 7%，但拐點在結構：青光眼 Cyclo G6 產品線營收 390 萬美元（年增 19%），探頭用量從 13,100 支升到 17,700 支，這是耗材、可重複收入的部分；視網膜線因中東局勢與中國去化放緩而下滑。公司同時把生產移到成本較低的代工廠、搬到較便宜的總部，Q2 營運現金流為正。據 Quiver Quantitative，CFO Romeo Dizon 已有 11 筆買進、合計約 3.7 萬股，我沒能核對 Form 4。風險：整體營收還在縮、系統銷售從 35 台掉到 18 台、毛利率數字我沒找到。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: IRIDEX (IRIX) makes ophthalmic lasers, with revenue of only about $12.6 million a quarter, a classic neglected micro-cap medtech name. Q2 revenue fell 7%, but the turn is in the mix: the glaucoma Cyclo G6 family brought in $3.9 million (+19%), and probe sales rose to 17,700 units from 13,100, the consumable, recurring part; retina fell on Middle East disruption and slower sell-through in China. The company is also moving production to lower-cost contract manufacturers and relocating to a cheaper headquarters, and Q2 operating cash flow was positive. Per Quiver Quantitative, CFO Romeo Dizon has made 11 purchases totaling about 37,000 shares; I could not verify the Form 4s. Risks: total revenue is still shrinking, system sales fell to 18 units from 35, and I did not find the gross margin figure. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: IRIDEX，青光眼探頭 17,700 支（去年 13,100），CFO 連續買進

tag: （回鍋，無新動態）Orion Group：訂單 7.2 億美元，股價比 CFO 買價還低
zh: Orion Group（ORN）做海事與混凝土工程，包含疏浚、橋梁與石油碼頭。6 月底總訂單約 7.22 億美元，其中海事 5.54 億，高於去年底的 4.8 億；3 月 6 日 CFO 以約 11.85 美元買進 4,218 股。8 月下旬股價約 9.27 美元，比 CFO 的買價低。風險：Q2 海事毛利下滑並出現營業虧損，設備稼動率與客戶延期都難預測。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Orion Group (ORN) does marine and concrete construction, including dredging, bridges and petroleum terminals. Total backlog was about $722 million at the end of June, with marine at $554 million versus $480 million at year-end; on March 6 the CFO bought 4,218 shares at about $11.85. In late August the stock was around $9.27, below the CFO's price. Risks: Q2 marine gross profit fell and an operating loss appeared, and equipment utilization and customer delays are hard to predict. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

tag: Five Star Bancorp：七位董事同日以 44 美元買進
zh: 7 月 22 日 Q2 財報當天，Five Star Bancorp（FSBC）至少有七位董事以每股 44 美元買進：Allbaugh 約 9.7 萬股（約 425 萬美元）、Perry-Smith 約 3.1 萬股，另有多位買 1,000 至 5,700 股。要小心的是，公司在同一時間定價了一次增資，募得約 1.306 億美元；如果董事買進是參與這次發行，訊號就比公開市場自願買進弱。這個細節要看 Form 4 的買進性質才能確認。

The caution is that the company priced a stock offering raising about $130.6 million at the same time; if the director buying was participation in that offering, the signal is weaker than voluntary open-market buying. The nature of each Form 4 purchase would settle that.

tag: Immersion：董事長兼 CEO Singer 10 月 7 日買進約 29 萬美元
zh: Immersion（IMMR）現在的主體是控股平台：持有 Barnes & Noble Education 約 32.6%（約 1,120 萬股）。據 Quiver Quantitative，董事長兼 CEO Eric Singer 在 10 月 7 日買進公司股票約 292,799 美元。要小心兩點：一，Immersion 股價近六個月已漲超過 30%，這不是「跌深後買」；二，FY2026（4 月底止）歸屬股東淨利只有 450 萬美元（每股 0.14 美元），前一年是 6,430 萬美元，第四季營收 2.70 億美元也低於去年同期的 2.849 億。內部人買進金額不小，但仍需對照 Form 4 確認是公開市場買進，以及它買的是公司還是 BNED 的折價。
en: Immersion (IMMR) is now essentially a holding platform, owning about 32.6% of Barnes & Noble Education (roughly 11.2 million shares). Per Quiver Quantitative, Chairman and CEO Eric Singer bought about $292,799 of company stock on Oct. 7. Two cautions: the stock is up more than 30% over six months, so this is not buying after a deep decline; and FY2026 (ended April 30) net income attributable to stockholders was just $4.5 million ($0.14 a share) versus $64.3 million a year earlier, with fourth-quarter revenue of $270.0 million below $284.9 million. The purchase is sizable, but the Form 4 should confirm it was an open-market buy, and what it really bets on is the company or a discount on its BNED stake.

Benzinga totals insider buying over the last 90 days at about $115,000 with no sales. The amounts are modest and sources differ on prices, so rely on Form 4; still, buying after a decline deserves a second look more than buying into strength.

tag: 判讀：金額只有區間，28 筆加起來相差近五倍
zh: STOCK Act 的申報只要求寫金額區間，不是實際金額。以 Salazar 這份來說，28 筆交易加總的下限約 15.4 萬美元、上限約 73.5 萬美元，差了將近五倍，所以你無法算出她押了多少錢。再加上申報最多可延遲 45 天，等你看到時，價位早已改變。所以這個頻道看的是「結構」：買賣比例、集中度、是否在同一產業——而不是跟單訊號。
en: STOCK Act disclosures only require dollar ranges, not exact amounts. In Salazar's filing the 28 trades sum to a floor of about $154,000 and a ceiling of about $735,000, nearly a five-fold gap, so you cannot work out how much she committed. Disclosure can also be delayed up to 45 days, so prices have moved by the time you read it. This channel therefore reads structure — buy/sell mix, concentration, sector overlap — rather than copy-trade signals.

stocks.n: 波克夏，Salazar 申報裡最常見的標的之一

tag: 下週：週三 CPI、週四零售銷售與 PPI，週一債市休市
zh: 9 月 CPI 在週三（10/14）美東上午 8:30 公布；零售銷售與 PPI 預定週四（10/15）。週一（10/12）是哥倫布日，債券市場休市，但股市照常交易。Truist 指出，這波牛市在 10/12 滿四年，累計上漲約 119%；Deutsche Bank 統計，期中選舉前一個月到後兩個月，標普 500 在過去 23 次中有 21 次上漲，但這只是歷史統計，不是預測。10/27 至 28 日是 FOMC。
en: September CPI comes Wednesday (Oct. 14) at 8:30 a.m. ET; retail sales and PPI are scheduled Thursday (Oct. 15). Monday (Oct. 12) is Columbus Day, so the bond market is closed while stocks trade as usual. Truist notes the bull market turns four years old on Oct. 12 with a gain of about 119%; Deutsche Bank says the S&P 500 rose in 21 of the last 23 midterm cycles, measured from one month before to two months after the election, but that is history, not a forecast. The FOMC meets Oct. 27 to 28.

stocks.n: 道瓊 ETF，牛市滿四年的大盤基準之一

tag: 下週重點財報：週二四大行、週三 BofA 與摩根士丹利
zh: 財報季由大銀行打頭陣：週二（10/13）是 JPMorgan、Goldman Sachs、Citigroup、Wells Fargo，週三（10/14）是 Bank of America 與 Morgan Stanley，週三同一天還有 9 月 CPI。市場想從銀行讀三件事：高利率下的淨利息收入、信用成本有沒有惡化、投資銀行與交易業務的熱度。接下來幾週才輪到區域銀行與工業、消費品公司，它們對成本與需求的說法，會決定本週 PepsiCo、Delta 提到的成本壓力是個案還是普遍現象。
en: Earnings season opens with the big banks: JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and Wells Fargo report Tuesday (Oct. 13), and Bank of America and Morgan Stanley on Wednesday (Oct. 14), the same day as September CPI. Investors want three things: net interest income at high rates, whether credit costs are worsening, and how hot investment banking and trading are. Regional banks and industrial and consumer companies follow in the coming weeks, and what they say about costs and demand will decide whether the pressure PepsiCo and Delta cited this week is isolated or broad.

stocks.n: JPMorgan，週二財報
花旗，週二財報
摩根士丹利，週三財報

tag: 成本壓力輪流出現，下一站是誰？
zh: 今天最值得注意的是：同一週，PepsiCo 因成本與通膨下修展望，Delta 因燃油貴約 5 億美元下修全年，而十年期殖利率仍在 5.24% 左右、消費者信心降到 46.3。三件事湊在一起，說明高利率與高成本同時在擠壓企業與消費者。股市週五仍上漲，代表市場暫時相信這些是個別問題。下週的 CPI 與大銀行財報，會是對這個假設的第一次實質檢驗。
en: The most notable thing today: in the same week PepsiCo cut its outlook on costs and inflation and Delta cut its full year because fuel ran about $500 million higher, while the 10-year yield is still near 5.24% and consumer confidence fell to 46.3. Together they say high rates and high costs are squeezing companies and consumers at once. Stocks still rose on Friday, meaning the market for now treats these as individual cases. Next week's CPI and big-bank earnings will be the first real test of that assumption.
